content.thinking: Reading the relevant files in full.

The `updateEndpoint` function drops the `enabled` field when it is `false` because of a falsy check. Disabling endpoints therefore never persists.

The delivery job also needs to fail when an endpoint is disabled, not just when it is missing. It currently only checks for missing endpoints and proceeds with delivery regardless of the enabled state.

A comment in createWebhook notes that only live endpoints consume allowance.

Switched-off endpoints must count toward allowance. The service should use `countEndpoints` instead of filtering by enabled status. Delivery jobs must fail when an endpoint is disabled, returning a clear error like "endpoint is switched off". Once enabled is persisted, `enqueueForOrg` will skip disabled endpoints automatically.
The action already counts all endpoints via listWebhooks length.

content.text: The toggle drops `enabled: false`, the quota only counts live endpoints, and the delivery job still sends to switched-off endpoints. I'll correct those three paths.
